obligations.text: A `rustev.definition/1` compiled without a profile and without a variant yields a `rustev.plan/2` byte-identical to today's, with the same `PlanId`, and every existing CLI output for it keeps its bytes.

An instantiated `rustev.plan/3` records the exact template document and its identity, the variant, the identity of every profile in the resolved chain and every resolved parameter value with its source, so its `PlanId` never depends on a version range, a pin or which other definitions were supplied.

A profile that sets a `fixed` parameter, sets a `bounded` parameter outside its bounds, sets an undeclared parameter or sets an ill-typed value is refused with the parameter named; no plan is produced.

A profile carries values for declared parameters only: it cannot add or remove an input, step, operator, expression, handler, rule, adjustment or action name, and no parameter value is interpreted as code, an expression or a reference.
Rustev never selects a profile or variant from a principal, tenant handle, scope or request content; the host names both for every compilation.

A profile's definition range resolves to the highest supplied definition version that satisfies it, or to the host's pin when the pin satisfies it; an unsatisfiable range or a pin outside the range is refused, listing the supplied versions.
`rustev.plan-diff/1` is a deterministic function of the two plan documents, and `rustev plan diff` output is golden-tested.

sectionHeadings: 034: Parameterized definitions, variants and tenant profiles (amends 002 and 006)
record.summary: An amendment of approved specs 002 and 006 (R-16), for #76 child B4. A definition may declare, as optional members this spec adds to the #76 track version `rustev.definition/2` (introduced by spec 032), typed, bounded parameters with lock levels (`fixed`, `bounded`, `free`), reference them from a closed set of literal positions, declare named variants and scope inputs, steps, handlers, rules and adjustments to them. A versioned profile document (`rustev.profile/1`) binds parameter values, may extend one other profile, and names its definition by a version range. Instantiation, a pure phase before compilation, resolves the range against the supplied definitions, resolves the overlay chain, checks every lock and bound, substitutes values and prunes the variant, yielding a definition without parameterization that the compiler compiles into a `rustev.plan/3` (the #76 track version, introduced by spec 032, to which this spec adds the optional member `instantiation`) whose `PlanId` binds the template, the variant, the profile chain and every resolved value. Adds `rustev plan diff` (`rustev.plan-diff/1`) and `rustev profile check`. A `rustev.definition/1` compiled without a profile still yields a byte-identical `rustev.plan/2` and `PlanId`. Approved (A-31); implementation is pending.
